detail.executionModeDescriptionNew: Jede Ausführung startet ein neues Gespräch, der vorherige Kontext wird nicht übernommen. Ideal für wiederkehrende Berichte oder Prüfungen, die unabhängig bleiben sollen.
detail.executionModeDescriptionExisting: Jede Ausführung setzt das gleiche Gespräch fort, frühere Ergebnisse bleiben verfügbar. Ideal für Folgeaufgaben, die auf früheren Ausführungen aufbauen.

status.defaultPrompt: Täglich um 10 Uhr die neuesten KI-Nachrichten suchen, zusammenfassen und einen Erkenntnisbericht ausgeben. (Bitte verwende den /cron-Skill, um eine geplante Aufgabe in Pavii.Ai zu erstellen.)

dailyPlan.description: Turns today's schedule and open commitments into a ranked plan.
dailyPlan.name: Daily plan
dailyPlan.prompt: Look at what is on my plate today - my schedule, open tasks and anything I flagged as unfinished. Give me a ranked plan for the day: what must happen, what can slip, and what I should drop. Keep it short enough to read in a minute, and say explicitly what you are leaving out.

growthReport.description: Pulls key metrics and explains what changed and why.
growthReport.name: Growth report
growthReport.prompt: Pull our key metrics for the past week and compare them with the week before. Tell me what moved, by how much, and your best read on why. Flag anything that looks like a data problem rather than a real change, and say where you are uncertain.

templates.heading: Start with an automation

inboxSummary.description: Summarises unread mail and lists what actually needs a reply.
inboxSummary.name: Inbox summary
inboxSummary.prompt: Summarise my unread mail. Group it into what needs a reply from me, what is waiting on someone else, and what is just noise. For anything needing a reply, note who is waiting and how long they have been waiting.

morningBriefing.description: Checks the sources you follow and reports what actually changed.
morningBriefing.name: Morning briefing
morningBriefing.prompt:
Check the sources I follow and tell me what actually changed since yesterday.

Sources (replace this list before saving):
- add a site, feed or dashboard here
- and another

Lead with anything that could change a decision I make today, then anything genuinely worth knowing, and drop the rest. Give each item one line of substance rather than a headline, plus a link. If nothing meaningful changed, say so in one line instead of padding the summary.

projectDigest.description: Summarises what moved this week and flags what is stalled.
projectDigest.name: Weekly project digest
projectDigest.prompt: Review my project workspace and summarise the week: what shipped, what is in progress, and what has not moved. Call out anything that looks stalled or blocked, and name the single thing most worth attention next week.

slackCatchUp.description: Digests overnight Slack activity and the asks pointed at you.
slackCatchUp.name: Slack catch-up
slackCatchUp.prompt: Catch me up on Slack since I last looked. Summarise the threads that matter, and list anything directed at me that is still waiting on a response. Separate genuine asks from things I was only copied on.

templates.subheading: Pick one to open it prefilled, then choose your assistant and time.
